headline: Gold Rebounds From One-Year Low as Lower Oil Prices Ease Inflation
summary: Gold rebounded from a one-year low as lower oil prices eased inflation concerns and buyers returned following three consecutive weeks of losses.
why: Gold is widely traded as a safe-haven asset and an inflation hedge. Its price movements are closely watched by investors assessing macroeconomic stability and currency strength.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Gold prices rebounded from a one-year low.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Lower oil prices eased inflation concerns, attracting buyers back to the market after three consecutive weeks of losses.
